title: Downtown Nashville Close, Comfortable & Convenient
description:
Back on Airbnb after a few year break. New listing, new decor (updated photos coming soon), same hospitality! We've hosted 1000's on guests and maintained super-host status for 5 years and running! 

This centrally-located home sits in a small community in downtown Nashville. There is a playground park on the street, great restaurant options, and it's walkable to the Farmers Market, Bicentennial, Germantown, etc. Close to downtown, the Gulch, Nissan Stadium, Bridgestone, and so much more!

The space
This cute two-bedroom home in the heart of downtown is comfortable, convenient, and perfect for small groups and families.

The downstairs has a wonderful open floor plan connecting the living room, kitchen, and dining space. The home has two full baths, one on each floor. Both bedrooms are spacious. 

The enormous master bedroom features a luxurious king bed with a dreamlike memory foam mattress, a very large walk-in closet, a great bathroom with a massive shower, and a bunk bed with a full size bed on the bottom and a twin on top (also with memory foam mattresses). The room has a flatscreen TV with full cable. 

The downstairs bedroom features a beautiful modern canopy bed with a memory foam mattress and a closet.

There are two sofas that can be slept on in the main room and a queen-sized air mattress is available upon request.

Guest access
The entire space, from the front porch, back deck, back yard and driveway are yours to enjoy!

Other things to note
Nest thermostat, Keurig coffee maker, towels, wifi, washer/dryer, two large flat-screen TVs, and our Kitchen is stocked for cooking in.
